findings.title: Profile omits agentdojo.local_model_raw_completion: 622 Llama turns with more <function= tags than parsed calls are never flagged
findings.evidence: Llama (local) assistant turns with a <function= tag 4,092; more tags than parsed calls 622 in 444 of 1,046 logs = 280 with >=1 call + 342 tag-only (all final; no log has >1). Tag-only outcomes: attacked u=F/s=F 296, u=T/s=F 18, u=F/s=T 1; benign u=F/s=T 25, u=T/s=T 2. qwen 0. The tacit profile (v1, 10 family quirks) declares no local_model_raw_completion (agentdojo-upstream l.297 and agentdyn l.209 do), so mapper._local_tags never runs. L2: 0 local_parse_drop_possible / local_model_tag_count, although 16/40 sampled Llama executions hold 18 such turns (12 tag-only finals). The phase-10d census 0/0 is circular (census.py l.168-171 counts mapper outputs). 342/1,046 = 32.70% [29.92, 35.60] of Llama runs end on a turn whose tag the local parser did not turn into a call (class I: a call may have been dropped).

findings.title: Paper's AgentDojo label counts include the 194 benign harness constants; the released loader and split files invert the label
findings.evidence: Raw (attack none, security): (benign,true) 194 (constant, #95), (attacked,true) 175, (attacked,false) 1,706, (attacked,null) 1. Paper (App. B.1, Tables 3-4) defines unsafe as completing the injected task and reports unsafe 369 / safe 1,706 = raw true/false, so it counts the 194 benign runs as unsafe. Loader tacit/data/agentdojo.py drops security None/error (l.85) and sets unsafe = int(security is False) (l.90); data/README expects unsafe=1706. Released split_seed42.json labels benign 194 -> 0, attacked successes 175 -> 0, resisted 1,706 -> 1 (stats unsafe 1,028+334+344), so the inversion reaches the labels behind the paper's AgentDojo detector results (Tables 1-2). Two readings fit: the table reports raw security counts under its definition, or the code inverts the paper's direction; both are a paper-code mismatch. Logs internally consistent.
findings.reproduction: python3 over ~/.agentprov/migration-work/precheck/tacit-agentdojo/l1-units-head.jsonl counting (facets.attack_dir=='none', outcomes.security); GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1 GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL=file git -C ~/.agentprov/staging/10c/tacit/Tacit.git show 995692d3:tacit/data/agentdojo.py | grep -n security; same for data/README.md and data/splits/split_seed42.json
findings.recommendation: Disclose in the dossier, datasheet and any manuscript use. Never use 369 as an ASR; use 175/1,881 (9.30% [8.07, 10.70]) or the 165 goal-datum re-score (PC-03). Our mapping already treats benign security as the harness constant. Contacting the authors is the user's decision.

verdicts.reasoning: Counts reproduce (keys facets.attack_dir / outcomes.security). Released split file independently confirms 194/175/1,706 and labels resisted runs unsafe. Loader l.85/l.90 as stated. arXiv v1 confirms Table 3 369 and the unsafe definition. AgentDojo semantics (#95) rule out a wrong expectation. A source-side label defect reading also supports S2. No exclusion involved. Corrections: Reproduction keys corrected; split-file evidence added; both readings stated. Applied.

findings.title: [CC-07, #181] All 10 banking IT1 successes rest on the checker precedence (no target IBAN in any attacker transfer)
findings.evidence: Attacked banking security-true: IT0 7, IT1 10, IT3 6, each with an executed attacker-bound transfer. IT0 7/7 and IT3 6/6 carry the goal datum; IT1 carries the target IBAN in 0/10 (0/11 attacker send_money calls, all args, punctuation stripped), though it appears in tool outputs of 9/10 logs. Installed agentdojo 0.1.35 InjectionTask1.security has the precedence defect in both default_suites v1 and v1_2 (logs ran v1.2.2). Goal-datum re-score: 165/1,881 = 8.77% vs logged 9.30%; qwen banking 29.86% vs 35.42% (-5.56 pp). This is a re-score against the goal datum (as mandate PC-01), not what a precedence-only fix would return (3/11 subjects contain 'me'). validity_defects covers #181 but omits tacit (PC-07); the per-arm consequence raises the severity to S2.
findings.recommendation: Widen the validity_defects scope with this count; report the re-scored ASR beside the logged one; flag only, never re-score in the corpus or exclude. Scope gap CC-09. Disclosure: logged ASR 9.30 % vs goal-datum re-score 8.77 %; qwen banking 35.42 % vs 29.86 %.
findings.artefact_proposal: Widen agentdojo.art.validity_defects: scope += tacit-agentdojo (head); expected += {snapshot="tacit-agentdojo:head", count=10, unit="executions", basis="pre-check 2026-10-15 b181.py: banking IT1 security true without the target IBAN in executed attacker transfers (#181, suite v1.2.2); IT0 0/7, IT3 0/6", status="proposed"}

verdicts.reasoning: b181.py reproduced; own variant (all args, all attacker calls, stripped) 0/11; IBAN seen in 9/10 logs; IT0/IT3 detection unbiased. Checker defect real in v1 and v1_2. Rates reproduce. Class per CC-07/R2; S2 since -5.56 pp in one arm and TACIT trains on the logged boolean; not S1. Corrections: Label 'strict' as goal-datum re-score; status proposed; state v1.2.2 carries the same defect. Applied.

CC-07: R2 expected-known S3 for #181 in every AgentDojo-format corpus (interbolt, melon, glitch, mohameduk, geryon aligned); the corpus-specific bias (qwen banking 35.42 -> 29.86 %) stays in the disclosure text and the outcome table, not in the severity.

findings.title: 31 Llama runs end on an empty final answer (bound 1%); probable #220
findings.evidence: 31/1,046 Llama logs (2.96% [2.10, 4.18]) end on a single exact-empty text block with no calls; qwen 0. Outcomes: attacked u=F/s=F 28, u=F/s=T 1; benign u=F/s=T 2 (s=T is the benign constant). All 31 follow a tool message; none has an earlier empty turn; histories 63.9k-153.4k content characters (median 110.6k) vs median 2.9k for the other 1,015 Llama runs (1.9% of them reach the smallest empty-final length); collect script serves --max-model-len 32768; agentdojo 0.1.35 LocalLLM chat_completion_request returns '' on any exception, giving exactly this shape. Probable #220 context overflow, not proven (debug line not logged). Harness-path outcomes bias Llama ASR and utility. No artefacts.toml entry or CC covers it (R1).
findings.recommendation: Record with the count (entry below); disclose beside the Llama ASR and utility. No exclusion.
